description: List NEAR House of Stake governance proposals from the vote.dao contract, newest first: id, HSP number, status (with lapsed deadlines called out), vote standing against quorum and approval thresholds, and the gov.near.org thread. Filter by status or by text in the title and description. Use for "what is NEAR governance voting on", "did HSP-027 pass". For one proposal in full use get_proposal.

query.description: Text to find in the title or description.
